comment: Crops, trees and the weather that grows them. Read by src/content/farming.ts. Times are real seconds of world time (the world clock keeps running while you are away, at the offline rate in trade.json's clock section). A plant passes through `stages` looks; the last is ripe. Growth runs faster in its own climate and slower elsewhere, faster still when watered or rained on. `gathering` is what each resource node in a zone gives, for how much labor, and how long it takes to come back. `animals` are raised in plot cells like crops: fed instead of watered (they only grow and produce while fed), and collected again and again once grown.
